title: Add a stronger post-personal-game 'what you learned' payoff
description: The personal About {Name} game should leave the user feeling like they genuinely learned something about the match, not just saw a score screen. After a personal round, summarize the match's revealed answers or highlights in a compact, attractive results panel before/alongside Chat now. This can reuse the existing profileAnswers data and stay mock-first.
acceptance_criteria: Completing an About {Name} round surfaces 3-7 memorable things learned about the match; the panel is useful before the profile is fully thawed and does not expose unrelated private data; chat CTA remains prominent; Playwright screenshots cover the personal-game result state.
notes: Reopened: not implemented in this bug-fix commit; post-personal-game payoff remains pending.
close_reason: Shipped to main: 'what you learned' panel after personal game, getLearnedFacts helper, learnedLabel on question defs

title: Fix post-game thaw display and last-game derivation
description: Game.tsx computes liveThaw as persisted match.thaw plus current-round answered progress whenever a game object exists. After completeGame updates persisted thaw, the want-to-chat/results phase can still have the completed game selected and double-count that round's progress, making the UI appear more thawed than Matches/Chat state. Also COMPLETE_GAME derives lastGameId with games.find(...) rather than the completed game or latest completed game, which can become stale after multiple rounds. Tighten completed-vs-live thaw derivation and lastGameId assignment.
acceptance_criteria: The post-game results screen shows the same thaw level that is persisted for the match after completion; live thaw is only applied while actively answering an incomplete game; lastGameId points at the game just completed or the latest completed game by timestamp; store/thaw tests cover multiple completed games; Playwright screenshots remain consistent across Game, Matches, and Chat.
close_reason: Fixed post-game thaw display and latest completed game tracking

title: Make the first icebreaker with a new match use About {Name}
description: The personal icebreaker is currently pinned in the category picker but optional. For a new match, the first game should privilege the match-specific About {Name} questions so the app feels less like generic trivia. After the first completed game, generic categories can return. Implement this without adding auth/onboarding friction; fall back gracefully to the category picker if a profile has no personal questions.
acceptance_criteria: For a match with no completed games and available profileAnswers, entering /game/:matchId starts or presents only the About {Name} first-game path with no random category choices; subsequent games show the normal category picker; profiles without personal questions still work; tests and screenshot walk cover the first-game and replay states.
notes: Reopened: not implemented in commit 17d06db; first-personal-game flow remains pending.
close_reason: Shipped to main: first icebreaker auto-starts About {Name} for matches with profile answers

title: Tune thaw pacing to reveal a match after one icebreaker
description: Current behavior requires two completed seven-question games to fully reveal a match portrait (THAW_PER_GAME = 0.5). That is likely too much friction for testers and may delay the product hook. Revisit thaw constants and live/reveal behavior so the first completed icebreaker can reveal the profile picture, or at minimum reveal enough by the end of the first game that the payoff feels immediate. Keep the mechanic centralized in src/lib/thaw.ts and update store/thaw tests plus Playwright screenshots.
acceptance_criteria: A completed first icebreaker produces a clear, satisfying profile-picture reveal or an explicitly chosen near-reveal state; thaw tests cover the new thresholds; scripts/screenshot.mjs matches the new expected reveal timing; visual screenshots confirm Game, Matches, and Chat stay coherent.
notes: Reopened: this session only fixed icebreaker-6bj. Thaw pacing has not been implemented yet.
close_reason: Shipped to main: THAW_PER_GAME 0.5→1.0, full reveal after first icebreaker

title: Revisit discover-card photo visibility before tester release
description: Discover currently sets DISCOVER_CARD_THAW = 0 and DISCOVER_CARD_REVEAL_PHOTO = false, so users swipe on a fully opaque generated silhouette rather than the actual bundled photo. This protects the reveal mechanic but may make the deck feel too blind and lower trust. Explore a better first impression: partial photo visibility, heavier frost on details, or a controlled preview that keeps the thaw payoff meaningful.
acceptance_criteria: Discover cards no longer feel like fully blind swipes unless that choice is consciously reaffirmed; implementation keeps matched/game reveal behavior intact; screenshots at 390x844, 375x667, and desktop show readable cards with no text/image clashes; the selected behavior is documented in code or issue notes.
close_reason: Shipped to main: DISCOVER_CARD_THAW=0.3, DISCOVER_CARD_REVEAL_PHOTO=true — partial frost shows real photo while preserving ThawReveal payoff
